summary.text: Cutting Flesh Transformation is a rank eight immortal killer move from Reckless Savage true inheritance. It sheds body tissue as living forms that the user can normally command like limbs.

claims.text: Deep in Myriad Statue Palace under Western Desert’s myriad statue desert, Thousand Transformations Ancestor activates the rank eight immortal killer move Cutting Flesh Transformation while enduring pain after his first myriad tribulation. His immortal body swells, meat lumps grow and burst, and year beasts emerge from the discarded flesh, including desolate and ancient year beasts.

He names cutting flesh transformation as one style of the immortal killer move suicide transformation from Reckless Savage true inheritance: whenever he uses it, life forms produced from his body can be manipulated like limbs because they are portions of that body. This cast is different. He used it to discard the heavily injured part of his immortal body and strip off time path dao marks left by a time path myriad tribulation; those marks became year beasts filled with heaven’s will, so they hate him and will not obey despite his methods. The loss also takes his own transformation path dao marks, leaving him with a small net dao mark loss after the tribulation rather than growth. Palace chains later capture the year beasts that attack him inside the house.
